description: Standing jobs: register one routing rule for the paying wallet. Watch fires and standing-job results for this wallet that match the filter also post to callback_url, byte for byte, with their own Idempotency-Key. filter.source_tool is wever_watch-fire or a schedulable tool name; filter.condition reads a field of the delivered report (for example /outcome equals failed, /result/report/verdict equals outside_window, or /observation/value above 120) with equals, not_equals, above, below, at_or_above, at_or_below or exists. Routing never changes the original delivery; it adds one. The rule ends at expires_at, up to 30 days ahead, or after max_deliveries. POST /api/alert-route. Standing jobs check and report: they run read-and-report Wever tools only and never move money, place orders or change state. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Every call carries X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route; a paid call adds Payment-Signature from the same wallet. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/standing-jobs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/standing-jobs/.

callback_url.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives a copy of each matching delivery, byte for byte.

expires_at.description: When the rule ends, up to 30 days ahead.

filter.description: source_tool, condition or both. Both must match.

field.description: JSON pointer or dot path into the report being delivered, for example /outcome, /result/report/verdict or /observation/value.

value.description: Compared exactly. Numbers and numeric strings compare as exact decimals. Omit for exists.

source_tool.description: wever_watch-fire for Wever Watch fires, or a schedulable tool name for results of standing jobs that run it.

label.description: Optional name shown in lists, reports and digests.

max_deliveries.description: Optional delivery count after which the rule completes.
